name: Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon Premium Trainer Box

releases.name: Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon Premium Trainer Box

description.text: Premium Trainer Box Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon, released on 8 December 2017: 20 booster packs, ten each of Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon, and 156 cards of 29 kinds for building decks, 44 Trainers, 4 Special Energy and 108 basic Energy, with XY and XY BREAK reprints among them. It also held acrylic damage counters, Poison and Burn markers, 64 sleeves found only in this box, a coin, a card box and a GX marker that is red instead of the usual blue, matching the red Ultra Beast GX cards.
